content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization problem; the valid coding and correct COB order provide no identified correction to resubmit. Although an appeal was already attempted, a formal appeal remains available under the published rules, and it is the only action shown to have paid similar claims at this payer (1/4). That evidence favors another appeal supported by the strong clinical documentation over an untested peer-to-peer review or prematurely transferring the balance.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
